summary: Tested Field Team Dashboard feature end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests passed (login, assigned retailers, portfolio summary, retailer dashboard, payment details, create indent, auth guards). Frontend: login redirect to /field-team/dashboard works, cumulative view shows 4 summary cards (Retailers=2, Immediately Payable=₹18,199, Overdue=₹15,596, Total Outstanding=₹20,802). Retailer mini-cards render Tamanna Mart & S Mart with upfront/commission %. Expanding card reveals Outstanding/Pending Indents/Today's Dispatches/Today's Value plus View Dashboard & Create Indent buttons. Dropdown lists both retailers; switching to Tamanna Mart shows individual dashboard with Outstanding/Payable/Net Sales/Rejection% cards, 6 count cards (Indents=116, Dispatches=167, Invoices=110, Rejections=1000, Payments=152, Credit Notes=70), Payment Details table with date-wise breakdown, and Create Indent header button. Create Indent modal opens with product dropdown (115 products), variant, quantity; submitting successfully closes modal and creates the indent. Back button returns to cumulative view.
critical_code_review_comments: field_team.py: assigned_to matching uses users.assigned_to == field_team_id string; ensure consistency in how retailers are assigned (single value vs array) — currently a retailer can only be assigned to one field-team user.
portfolio-summary invoice_date parsing assumes ISO string; datetime path exists but non-string non-datetime silently skipped (continue) — could hide bad data.
Create Indent modal in Dashboard.js uses non-data-testid selectors for product/variant selects and qty input; consider adding data-testid for reliable future tests.
Retailer dashboard endpoint returns up to 500 indents/dispatches/invoices unbounded — may become heavy for large retailers; consider pagination.
